boundary: Summaries state only information available on the public page or in a public search index. Paywalled articles are labelled and are not bypassed.

items.title: Kimberley and Pilbara local news briefing, 20 August 2026
items.summary: ABC reports first production at Fortescue's Christmas Creek green-iron pilot, construction of a new Onslow Iron accommodation camp, and a Federal Court challenge concerning Chevron's Gorgon environment plan.
items.relevance: Three direct Pilbara operating, workforce-accommodation and legal-context developments in one regional bulletin.

items.title: Union officials blocked in BHP Pilbara port right-of-entry row
items.public_basis: Headline and public search-index synopsis only
items.summary: The publicly indexed synopsis reports a right-of-entry dispute at BHP's Port Hedland operations, including union allegations that officials were barred and police were called.
items.relevance: A reported escalation in the active BHP Port Operations matter. The underlying allegations require court, police or other public records before being treated as established.

items.title: Stoush between BHP and unions at Port Hedland escalates with WA Police called
items.public_basis: Headline, byline and publication date publicly readable
items.summary: The public page identifies a further report about the BHP–union dispute at Port Hedland and police attendance; substantive article text remains subscriber-only.
items.relevance: Independent media coverage of the same reported right-of-entry escalation, but not independent proof of the contested conduct.

items.title: Mardie Salt to test potash by-product
items.summary: BCI Minerals awarded a contract for a sulphate-of-potash pilot plant at Mardie Salt to test whether a salt-production by-product can be used as fertiliser.
items.relevance: A diversification and project-execution development at a current Pilbara operation.

items.title: Fortescue achieves first hot metal using electric smelting
items.summary: Fortescue's Christmas Creek project produced molten metal from blended ore in its electric smelting furnace; commissioning is to continue in stages and commercial-scale production remains an unresolved challenge.
items.relevance: A concrete operating milestone, with the article preserving the distinction between a pilot result and commercial-scale green-iron production.

items.title: BHP to test static and dynamic charging at Jimblebar
items.summary: BHP plans FY2027 trials of high-power static charging and Caterpillar dynamic energy transfer at Jimblebar as part of assessing battery-electric haul-truck fleet viability.
items.relevance: A direct Pilbara technology and future-workforce capability trial; the equipment remains under development and is not yet commercially available.

items.title: Pilbara Ports sees 63 million tonnes handled in July
items.summary: Pilbara Ports recorded 63.8 million tonnes of throughput in July 2026. Port Hedland handled 45 million tonnes, including 44.2 million tonnes of iron ore exports.
items.relevance: Source-linked operating context for the region's export system, including the BHP Port Operations matter.
